## 2. AI SEO criteria

According to Searchbloom, the top scoring criteria for AI SEO companies include measuring AI visibility, earning brand presence on other people's pages AI reads, technical and structured-data foundation, content and entity authority, and documented results. According to Searchbloom, aI SEO includes mostly traditional SEO work, with the new aspect being measurement of AI visibility and external page citations.

## 3. AI visibility

According to Searchbloom, searchbloom measured 68,631 AI answers in its category where its own website was cited 8.9% of the time, highlighting that most AI citations come from external pages. According to Searchbloom, the best AI SEO company manages SEO work, measures AI visibility daily, and provides a list of outside pages worth earning, leaving PR, social, sponsorships, and partner listings to the client's own team.

## 6. According to Searchbloom, only three companies publish prices.

According to Searchbloom, only three companies publish prices: Searchbloom starts SEO at $3,000 a month with no lengthy contracts, The SEO Works from GBP 1,500 a month, and Siege Media from $8,000 a month. According to Searchbloom, eight of the nine companies publish a dated AI search result and all nine say how they track AI visibility.
